question: What supreme identity is affirmed of the deity in this salutation?
premises: The deity is identified as Brahmā alone
The deity is addressed as lord of the universe
The deity is addressed as having the form of Brahmā
inference: The addressed deity is affirmed as Brahmā himself, lord of the universe in Brahmā's form.
plain_english: You alone are Brahmā, O lord of the universe, O one whose form is Brahmā; obeisance be to you.
